shared_elements: tall vertical stone monument with rounded/tapering top
standing human-like figures with arms shown
small repeated linear signs or motifs across the surface
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented carved stones with a rounded or pointed top, decorated in low relief with human-like forms, disc motifs and horizontal dividing bands, which gives a broadly comparable first impression. The differences dominate on inspection: A is a thick, volumetric statue whose whole block is shaped into a body (head, shoulders, torso with a chest disc) in bold weathered relief, while B is a thin flat slab carrying a shallow, finely incised two-register scene of separate small figures and objects — different scale, technique and organising logic.
